name: idf: a board file with its library becomes an assembly — the board (FR-4, 1.6 mm, rounded corner, cutout, holes) and U1, C1, U2 placed; J9 has no package
eval:
(async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); const emn = ".HEADER
BOARD_FILE 3.0 "Demo ECAD" 2026/11/25.10:00:00 1
demo_board MM
.END_HEADER
# A 100 x 80 board with a quarter-round corner (radius 10) and a round cutout
.BOARD_OUTLINE ECAD
1.6
0 0 0 0
0 90 0 0
0 100 10 90
0 100 80 0
0 0 80 0
0 0 0 0
1 50 40 0
1 56 40 360
.END_BOARD_OUTLINE
.DRILLED_HOLES
3.2 5 5 NPTH BOARD MTG ECAD
3.2 5 75 NPTH BOARD MTG ECAD
.END_DRILLED_HOLES
.PLACE_KEEPOUT ECAD
TOP 3.0
0 80 60 0
0 95 60 0
0 95 75 0
0 80 75 0
0 80 60 0
.END_PLACE_KEEPOUT
.PLACEMENT
SOIC8 "LM358" U1
20 20 0 90 TOP PLACED
CAP_RAD "100uF" C1
70 30 0 0 TOP PLACED
SOIC8 "LM358" U2
20 60 0 0 BOTTOM PLACED
NOPKG "X" J9
10 10 0 0 TOP PLACED
.END_PLACEMENT
"; const emp = ".HEADER
LIBRARY_FILE 3.0 "Demo ECAD" 2026/11/25.10:00:00 1
.END_HEADER
.ELECTRICAL
SOIC8 "LM358" MM 1.75
0 -2.45 -1.95 0
0 2.45 -1.95 0
0 2.45 1.95 0
0 -2.45 1.95 0
0 -2.45 -1.95 0
.PROP CAPACITANCE 0
.END_ELECTRICAL
.ELECTRICAL
CAP_RAD "100uF" THOU 472.4409
0 0 0 0
0 125.98425 0 360
.END_ELECTRICAL
"; window.__idf = { emn, emp }; await m.idf.importIdfBoard('demo.emn', emn, { library: emp }); await sleep(1500); const p = m.state.doc.project; const asm = p.assemblies[0]; const board = p.parts.find((x) => x.material === 'fr4'); const { rep } = await import('/src/cad/kernel.js'); const v = rep().measureVolume(m.actions.buildPart(board).body); const area = 100 * 80 - (100 - Math.PI * 25) - Math.PI * 36 - 2 * Math.PI * 1.6 * 1.6; return JSON.stringify({ active: p.active.kind, comps: asm.components.map((c) => c.name), board: Math.abs(v - area * 1.6) < 1e-4, u2: asm.components.find((c) => c.name === 'U2').position, missing: asm.idf.missing, bodies: m.viewport.bodies.size >= 4 }); })()

name: idf: exported to .emn and .emp; read back they give the same board and placements
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const files = []; await m.actions.withExportSink(async (name, type, content) => { files.push({ name, type, content }); return true; }, () => m.idf.exportIdf()); const { readIdfBoard, readIdfLibrary } = await import('/src/cad/idf.js'); const b = readIdfBoard(files[0].content); const lib = readIdfLibrary(files[1].content); return JSON.stringify({ names: files.map((f) => f.type), thick: b.thickness, holes: b.holes.length, place: b.placements.map((p) => [p.refdes, p.side, p.rotation, Math.round(p.x), Math.round(p.y)]), pkgs: [...new Set([...lib.values()].map((x) => x.geometry))].sort() }); })()
